messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recognition bridge grant review for high-impact IC

Team —

Following last week's 1:1s and the re-org changes on Platform, I'm proposing a short, targeted package for one of our senior ICs (Samir P.) who will be transitioning into the new infra team lead role next month. Concern: if we don't provide a visible recognition and an accelerated equity refresh, we risk losing momentum given competing offers we've heard about.

Proposal (summary attached):
- One-time spot award: $12,500 (paid on next payroll)
- Accelerated equity refresh: small bridge grant of 0.15% (4-year schedule, 1-year cliff)
- Effective date: 10/15/2026; payroll + equity admin to execute by 10/31

Rationale: high impact on ongoing services migration, critical knowledge transfer, and immediate retention risk due to external interest. I kept the ask conservative compared to the benchmarking file — the attached spreadsheet breaks down cost centers and comp chargebacks.

Ask:
1) Marissa / Neha: confirm People Ops feasibility and any precedent constraints.
2) Laura / Markus: routing for approval — is Finance sign-off required at this level (>$10k) or should we route via compensation committee?
3) If approved, I will kick off DocuSign and payroll paperwork — Jordan (ADP) will need a scanned approval.

Attachment: 20261005-proposal-breakdown.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — good, pragmatic framing. A few notes:

- Financial routing: Since the spot award is >$10k but under $25k and the equity grant is a one-off bridge, route to Finance for approval and mark the funding to cost center ENG-PLAT-03. Markus: can you confirm Finance availability for a quick review?
- People Ops: confirm whether the bridge grant will be considered a refresh or a supplemental grant from a legal/compliance perspective. Neha, do we need exec sign-off for equity above 0.10%?
- Approvals: once we have sign-off I want a short SBAR (Situation/Background/Assessment/Recommendation) 1-pager for the exec folder — I'll attach it to the DocuSign envelope.

If we can get Finance and People Ops alignment by EOD Wednesday 10/7 I will sign off and mark as approved for payroll processing.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Org
Redwood Inference
